fullDescription: A sophisticated developer-centric dark mode chat interface featuring a persistent navigation sidebar, glassmorphism elements, and technical execution blocks. Optimized for AI coding assistants, SaaS technical dashboards, and terminal-integrated tools. Key aesthetics include deep space grays (#0f1115, #181b21, #232730), accent blues, and a clear distinction between user input, agent reasoning, and terminal output. Layout utilizes a bento-like sidebar and a centered, readable 768px chat container.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-performance dark-themed AI Agent interface with a left-hand navigation sidebar, terminal-style output blocks, and a clean, responsive chat layout. It uses a mix of Inter for UI and JetBrains Mono for technical data.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-end dark mode UI using the following palette: Base Background #0f1115, Surface #181b21, Panel/Sidebar #232730, Muted Text #94a3b8, and Main Text #e2e8f0. Primary accent is #3b82f6 (blue), success is #10b981 (green), and warning/process is #f59e0b (amber). Typography must pair 'Inter' (400-600 weight) for UI elements with 'JetBrains Mono' (400-500 weight) for code and terminal blocks. Borders should be 1px solid using #1f2937. Input fields use rounded-2xl corners (16px) with a subtle shadow and 1px border. Buttons and sidebar items use 8px (rounded-lg) corner radius. Use smooth transitions (300ms ease-in-out) for sidebar slides and hover effects.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sidebar Navigation
Implement a 260px wide sidebar with background #232730 and a right border #1f2937. Top section contains a 'New Chat' button with a plus icon, border #374151, and a hover effect that glows white/5. The middle section is a scrollable list of recent conversations. Active items have a background of #3b82f61a (10% blue) and text color #3b82f6. Hover states for inactive items use white/5 transparency. On mobile, the sidebar should slide in from the left using a translate-x transform triggered by a hamburger menu.

### Main Header
A sticky header with background #232730 and bottom border #1f2937. Left side features a status indicator: an avatar with a 32x32px size, background #3b82f633, and a pulsing green dot (#10b981) indicating 'Active'. Center text includes a title and 'Active' status label in 12px muted text. Right side contains a settings gear icon with an 8px rounded hover state.

### Chat Message Feed
A vertical scrollable area. User messages are plain text on #0f1115 background. Agent responses are encapsulated in a subtle #181b214d (30% surface color) background container that spans the full width. Inside agent blocks, content is restricted to a 768px (3xl) max-width container. Each message includes an avatar (User: #374151 gray; Agent: #3b82f61a blue with bot icon).

### Process & Terminal Blocks
Technical content is divided into 'Agent Reasoning' and 'Terminal Execution'. Reasoning uses a collapsible 'details' element with #232730 background, amber circuit icon, and 14px text. Terminal blocks use a black #0d0f12 background, JetBrains Mono font, and a horizontal scrollbar. Shell prompts use green '$' characters. Success messages within terminal use #3b82f6 blue text.

### Input Bar
A fixed bottom input area. The input container is a 768px max-width box with #232730 background, 16px rounded corners, and a 1px border. It features a multiline-capable textarea and a floating 'Send' button (arrow-up icon) in the bottom right corner with a white background and black icon. Include a tiny 11px disclaimer text centered below the input.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Collapsible Technical Block — A custom styled details/summary component for nested technical logs.
Create a 'details' element with `group` class. Summary should have no default marker, display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: space-between, and a hover:bg-white/5 transition. The content area inside should have a top border #1f293720 and a darker background #00000033. The chevron icon should rotate 180 degrees when the parent 'details' is open.

### Status Pulse Indicator — An animated online status dot.
A 8x8px span with background #10b981. It must contain a child span with the same color, absolute positioning, and an 'animate-ping' animation with 75% opacity to create a radar-like notification effect.
